description: Coverage regression thresholds based on historical CI data

cuda.note: CUDA is the primary platform with strictest requirements

other.note: Other platforms: focus on functionality, coverage requirements relaxed

absolute.description: Fail if coverage drops more than platform-specific threshold from baseline

statistical.description: Daily (nightly stage) uses 3-sigma against a 14-run sliding window (advisory)

storage.description: Baseline fetched from most recent successful run on main branch

enforcement.note: Currently non-blocking (continue-on-error), will be enforced after calibration period
